laningPhase.description: The laning phase is approximately the first 6 levels and around the first 7 minutes. These are rough guidelines rather than fixed time limits. The phase ends whenever PA can no longer play safely in lane, or when she chooses to leave the lane. PA generally prefers to stay in lane for longer because her jungle farming speed is poor and she usually lacks a reliable way to survive in the jungle before obtaining the Ring component for Battle Fury.
strengths: Can secure ranged creeps safely with Stifling Dagger
One of the strongest heroes at level 2, with very high kill potential after reaching level 2
Can help her support during trades similarly to a ranged hero
weaknesses: Low base HP and poor HP regeneration
Relatively weak from level 4 onward unless she has secured kills and built an advantage
Uses her spells frequently, making Magic Stick particularly effective against her

preBKB.description: Early-Mid Game. This phase begins after the laning phase and lasts until PA obtains her first BKB. PA is generally weak during this stage unless she secured kills during the laning phase and built an early advantage. The exact duration varies depending on how the game develops and when PA completes BKB.
strengths: Can push lanes without appearing on the minimap while Blur is active
Stifling Dagger provides vision and slow with a low cooldown, making it easier for PA to secure assists during teamfights
Can quickly burst low-armor heroes when she is ahead
weaknesses: Heavily dependent on Battle Fury for fast farming
Relies heavily on Immaterial's evasion for survivability, which is relatively ineffective at this stage because many heroes rely heavily on spells and magic damage
Has a relatively weak level 6 power spike and usually struggles to keep her own tower alive
Has very poor farming speed before obtaining Battle Fury and cannot efficiently farm stacks

postBKB.description: Late Game: Post-BKB. PA has a very strong power spike after purchasing BKB. BKB provides her with a major window to safely participate in teamfights, and whenever BKB is ready, she can look to join fights and act as the team's primary damage dealer. This phase begins once PA obtains BKB, regardless of the exact game time.
strengths: Scales exceptionally well with additional attack damage because of her extremely high critical strike damage
Lifesteal is highly effective on PA because of the large amount of physical damage she can deal
One of the strongest heroes for purchasing Divine Rapier when attempting to come back from a losing game
The level 25 Triple Stifling Dagger talent is extremely powerful and significantly improves her impact in fights
Armor reduction is extremely valuable for PA because it significantly increases the damage of her physical attacks
weaknesses: Highly dependent on BKB's cooldown for safely participating in fights
Deals only physical damage, making her struggle against heroes that become immune to physical damage through Ghost effects and against heroes with naturally very high armor
If PA fails to secure kills during her BKB timing, the following fight can become much easier for the enemy team

general: If you want to help Phantom Assassin (PA) survive and escape a bad situation, do Not run towards her. Stay within Blink Strike range whenever possible so PA can Blink on you.
PA has a lot of Damage but generally lacks CC (Crowd Control). Try to provide that for her instead of getting more damage.

PA prefers not to be the first one to Blink in during a fight. Try to start the engagement around her when she is ready, to set up a good trade for her. (For example, tank the enemy's first stun so they cannot stun PA immediately after she Blinks in.)
laningPhase: Try to secure enough experience from the first waves to reach level 2 before the enemy. If necessary, push the lane to reach level 2 before the enemy does. (If your creeps are alive and theirs are dead, you will get level 2 before they do.)
Make sure to have enough mana, HP (Health Points), and consumables to take a fight at level 2.

Trading with the enemy support around PA is usually good, as she can simply throw a Dagger from a distance while farming. (Usually, it is better to focus on the enemy's squishy support rather than the enemy's tanky offlaner.)
After level 3, PA is not that powerful. Try to separate the lane by pulling the small camp and trade farm with the enemy without fighting.

If the enemy does not have a powerful kill duo, rotating toward your offlane and applying pressure when the enemy offlaner is around level 5 can be a good way to attract attention away from PA's lane, allowing her to stay in lane longer in a 1v1 situation.

If the item is good for your hero, getting a Blight Stone will help PA deal more damage in lane, especially against low-armor heroes. (You can check the enemies' armor before the game begins. Against heroes with 3 or less armor, Blight Stone can be a good option. Do check PA's items so you do not both buy it, as the item's debuff will not stack.)

As a Midlaner, it is usually more effective to gank away from PA (unless you can take the enemy tower for her, in which case it will be very effective to do so, as taking the tower will reduce her interaction with the enemy). The less attention PA's lane gets, the better.
preBKB: Before she gets BF (Battle Fury), PA does not farm that fast, so do not focus on her. It is more effective to help other lanes and attract attention away from PA's lane. (Unless she had a very successful lane with some kills, in which case it is better to leave her alone.)
It is very effective to take the enemy safelane tower before she gets BF. That way, she can farm more safely and efficiently.
PA is not good at protecting her own backline, so as a backliner, it is better to prioritize items that keep YOU alive first. (Such as Glimmer for Supports.)
Unless you are confident you will win, avoid long fights, as PA is not good at fighting before BKB (Black King Bar) and you may end up in a 4v5 situation.
Do not ask a PA without BKB to join fights. Know that it is better if she is just farming.
postBKB: Check PA's inventory and be ready with Smoke when she is close to completing BKB. Taking a fight with the Powerspike of a fresh BKB will be a great way to take advantage of the timing, even if you are behind.
If you are a Core, try to time your items so you finish your own Core item at the same time as or before PA's BKB, so you can hit a bigger Powerspike together.

Try to help PA save her BKB with your items and spells when you can. Getting items that give her a Dispel, such as Lotus Orb, or Magic Resistance, such as Glimmer Cape, can be very effective. Spells that give her Magic Immunity can also be very effective.
Providing vision on the enemy's backline, especially their save Heroes, can be very effective for PA.

If the enemy has BKB-piercing spells (such as Roar or Black Hole), it will be hard for PA to jump in. If you can force the enemy to use those spells on you and give PA an opening, it can win a fight. (Do not let the enemy control PA during her BKB.)
